headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text: Okay the developer next door Josh Campbell (604-754-7802) with Howdy Homes has planted trees very close to the property line (11 oak trees!). They are also right next to the sewer clean out. Two trees are directly under an oak at the property next door. This is a ridiculous placement. Please contact the developer or me next door.

Traffic signal flashing again this morning. Please contact me and let me know why this is repeatedly occurring- second time this week and has been occurring frequently over the last few weeks/months. Very dangerous with cyclists, pedestrians, vehicles all trying to navigate a very busy and confusing intersection.

Howard ln west to east traffic light only stays green for 5 seconds every night after 9pm, this is not normal, only 3 card goes and 5  other cars goes jn red which is very dangerous. Something needs to change with this light schedule

Giant dangerous potholes leading to sidewalk that is old and not blind people accessible. can y'all fix this? it is a extreme ankle breaking hazard and I've already hurt myself once, y'all are not fixing it. nobody's doing anything and everybody keeps trying to give the job to somebody else or not doing it
items.address: 7412 N Mopac Expy Svrd SB, Austin

items.text: I’ve seen countless people coming west bound on slaughter to turn south down Menchaca that turn even after the light is green for people going east on slaughter. It could just be people being careless and turning when the light is red but in case it’s a light issue can you please take a look? It happens almost every time I’m heading east on slaughter at the intersection.

Animal cruelty online from an alleged Austin, TX citizen. 
The name on the profile is Nelson Hernandez, he is capturing cats because he alleges they "eat" their chickens. He doesn't say explicitly what he does to them but he implies he tortures them. Can we investigate further please? We can easily track him because he shares about everything on his social media

Alley street light out. Please replace with the older style warm/yellow lights, not the cool/blue lights. It’s right outside my bedroom window, and the warm light is much easier to block/not absurdly bright. Thank you!

Luna is again and again way too loud. Every week I cannot sleep because of them. This is ridiculous, even the people leaving reviews say that the music is too loud. At this point they are just trying to annoy people!

Loud bass, drums, AND band playing in the area of rainey house half step and Lucille. I mean… this is just insanity. My apartment is shaking on the 40th floor. No way this is within decibel range. Absolutely no way. Why are you only reactive about this stuff? Pls implement pro activity. I’m sick of these bars not complying.

These dogs post up in the un fenced front yard and run into the road barking at me and my dog. This is dangerous and can lead to a dog fight. I opened this ticket up at the beginning of the month and it was closed out. Same issue is happening.

LOOSE DOG tan pitbull/lab male dog running around near w parmer ln at 7/11 initially dog then ran underneath bridge under w parmer ln near Zaviya Grill. Dog has grey/green collar with silver chain collar, dog seemed friendly but I couldn’t catch him.

An abandoned residential trash bin was left in the street. We moved it onto the grass next to the sidewalk to prevent it from obstructing traffic, but it is still abandoned on the public right-of-way. It has been there for several days and needs to be removed.

The water department fixed a water leak and you can see they left a large  divot in the street. I hit that divot last night with my vehicle and it knocked my alignment off. Also you will see they repaired the sidewalk with asphalt instead of concrete. They are pretty new sidewalks that need to be repaired properly.

Menchaca southbound protected left traffic light at Davis at 4pm on Saturday only lasts 7 seconds, only 4-5 cars make it through. North/South traffic clears with plenty time to spare. Please donate a few extra seconds to the southbound protected left.

Late last night a large dog was barking in our yard and banging on a rain barrel on the front corner of our house.  Today our front step, driveway, and the sidewalk have big bloody paw prints from here to 1810 Krizan.  The prints look like maybe the dog’s own blood, like it might be hurt.  2 big, loud, muscular dogs often get out from 1810 Krizan.  Other instances of blood and dead small animals h

Bike lane marking disappears — The bike lane on northbound South Lamar loses its markings for the stretch immediately north of Menchaca Road, inaccurately signaling drivers in the far east lane that there’s no need to look for bikists

Piles of trash in pedestrian right of way at Ben White and Menchaca underpass. Please remove transients and clean up litter. This area near the Sunrise Church requires daily enforcement of anti littering, loitering, and camping laws.

Inn Cahoots / IYKYN is blasting music loudly again, exceeding the decibel limit. For your information, they will receive a citation or you will speak with management as usual, yet they will disregard you and repeat the behavior from Thursday through Sunday the following week.

Homeless Encampment on the side of mopac on the Scofield exit right across from HEB on parmer/ mopac. Tents and garbage littering the street. Called it in last week and it was scheduled for cleanup by the homeless department on the 14th but the city failed to clean it up and now it’s getting larger by the day…
items.address: 12421 N Mopac Expy Svrd NB, Austin

items.text:
Leftover sediment from an Austin water work operation from 10510 school house lane north to lake creek.  Work order 2370932

WSP requested they order a street sweeper to clean up the sediment from the work. And rain is coming so if this can be done today. That would be great.

Employee Kenzie Green was bitten on her right index finger while holding a cat in exam assessment for Katelyn. The Patient was fine until they went to get the BP. Patient reacted to the alcohol on their paw pad and lashed out. 

Dr. Campbell has notified the owner. Patient is up to date on their rabies. Kenzie is going out to Urgent Care right now.
items.address: 7501 N Capital of Texas Hwy NB, Austin

items.text:
The Beauford Drive part of the sign at the intersection needs repaired please. (I think it just needs straightened up and tightened.)
Thank you!

A small box (roughly 15 to 20 lbs) fell out of a truck into the street. I have removed it from the road and placed it safely on the side of the road, but it still needs to be cleared and picked up by city crews.

Brown pitbull loose on hollybluff st, lives at 1115 hollybluff. Their fence is broken, this dog is out several times a week, in the road where it could be hit by a car. It barks at people. It scares children. It is a road hazard. The owners have no interest in keeping their dog fenced and safe.

The dog is left outside all day in the heat without adequate shelter and water. It barks incessantly like it is in distress. The owners have not responded to repeated messages to take the dog inside. The treatment of their dog is a violation of the Texas Safe Outdoor Dogs Act. This law strictly prohibits leaving dogs tethered or confined outside during extreme weather advisories without adequate s

Trash and (adult) human feces in children’s playscape. My wife and I daily walk this park and clean up, especially around the playscape. Over the last week several individuals have increasingly strewn trash around. Today was the worst (so far). I cleaned up foodstuffs, clothing, personal items, and feces. Yes, human sh**. I don’t fault homeless for being in the park but using the playscape, where

The area where the Multi Use Path running alongside the southbound MoPac service road turns to meet with the Domain mall parking lots is covered in shattered glass on multiple places. I've requested assistance with this multiple times in the past, as it's a hazard for the cyclists, walkers, and dogs that use that underpass every day, but every request has gotten closed without resolution. This is

There are potholes between Runberg Lane and Colony Creek Drive. One of the potholes was filled (poorly) following a recent request, but the other was left unrepaired. At this point, the condition of the entire road has deteriorated enough that it would benefit from being repaved rather than receiving additional patchwork repairs.

North and South.

Streetlight out with a bike may use full lane sign. Across the street one lamp before it on a curb in front of Zalat Pizza is missing a bulb altogether. 363067 is the one without a cover and bulb, number pulled off Google Maps and was blurry so may be off.

The utility box on Southridge Dr/Southport Rd behind my yard is covered in graffiti. My city council member did not respond to my request for improving this issue on public property. Trying all resources before attempting to get the community together to improve it ourselves. The box is north of the Shepherd’s convenience store.

traffic light at ut austin west mall and guadalupe street did not change for over five minutes. i and other pedestrians on the east side of the street were waiting for an extremely long time after having pressed the cross button and the light still didn’t change. it may have taken even longer, but i decided to just leave and cross elsewhere

Active barn swallow nest was removed. Nest was present at 2:30pm today. Gone by 5:15pm today. Parent was sitting in nest for the past couple weeks and as recently as today. we believe we heard baby birds on Sunday evening in the nest. No sign of nest or birds. We asked apartment management and they indicated they knew nothing about removal

Construction in the lot next to us is making it hard to access our alley (which is the only way in or out of all 8 or so houses in the alley). They block our cars in every day. We have asked them not to but they keep doing it. The alley is a public roadway, but they’re treating it like their driveway.

Overgrown Tree Obstructing Sidewalk at 12701 cardinal flower drive 

A residential tree adjacent to the sidewalk has branches extending into the pedestrian path and does not provide the required minimum vertical clearance for safe passage.
New development has new oak trees planted too close to adjacent house and directly under more mature oak in adjacent house. Also way too many trees! They will damage the foundation of both houses.

Vehicle is parked in the handicap spot but may be using a fake placard. It has Texas plates but not a Texas official placard. It is parked on the first floor entrance to the parking garage on your right as you enter the complex.
A neighbor had these out as trash and someone brought them to the creek. We've had issues in the past with homelessness and/or the wrong people hanging around, so these really need to get removed.

Someone dumped a beat up piano on park grounds as you enter Eastwoods Park from Leonard St. using the walking bridge. It is about to fall apart onto the sidewalk, partially blocking that entrance and/or end up in Walker Creek.
Garbage strewn around the cul-de-sac that has been here for months and has hazardous material like glass and construction materials that are unsafe for animals and young children in the area

This dog will not allow anyone to walk past without barking incessantly and approaching them in a threatening way. It is a pitbull. It does not appear that the owners are home and perhaps the dog got out from their gate.
